own_solution.law: Calorimetry (energy conservation in an insulated container): m_c c_c (T_c - T_f) = m_w c_w (T_f - T_w); rise = m_c c_c (T_c - T_w)/(m_c c_c + m_w c_w).
assumptions: perfectly insulated, container absorbs no heat (stated)

notes: m_c c_c = 192.5 J/K, m_w c_w = 1674.4 J/K; rise = 192.5 x 80 / 1866.9 = 8.2490 K (T_f = 301.249 K). With 0.95 kg water: m_w c_w = 3976.7 J/K; rise = 15400/4169.2 = 3.6938 K. Earlier-experiment sentences are excluded by 'Nothing from any other experiment is left in the first container'; second-container sentences have no path. TD942 and TC375 use 'a small amount' instead of 0.55 kg, so they do not carry the same number as their apparent twins.
